weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.description: A short narrow blade from a world that favoured close work — the riveted grip wrap has been replaced twice, once with oiled cord, once with a strip cut from a saddle.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.description: The flanged head is cast iron from a Kethara foundry, the haft spliced from two lengths of ash where the original snapped and was joined rather than replaced.

weapons.name: Morningstar
weapons.description: A broad iron head fitted with eight square-section spikes; the pommel cap is a different alloy, a later replacement that doesn't quite match in colour.

weapons.name: Quarterstaff
weapons.description: A dense foreign hardwood, one end charred where someone used it to stir a fire and decided the grip was serviceable anyway.

weapons.name: Sling
weapons.description: Braided cord worn smooth at the pouch from use; the leather cup has been cut from a larger hide and folded twice, stitched with something that isn't quite thread.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.description: The socket is old Verathi ironwork; the shaft is a replacement of pale foreign wood, and the two materials meet at a winding of raw copper wire.

weapons.name: Handaxe
weapons.description: The head is punched and stamped in a style no Verge smith recognises; the haft is new, fitted here, still pale where it hasn't been touched by weather.

weapons.name: Scimitar
weapons.description: The curve of the blade follows a geometry that suggests a culture that fought on horseback; traded or carried through a rift, now living a second life on the Verge.

weapons.name: Shortbow
weapons.description: A self bow shaped from a single dense stave, one face perpetually slightly damp and the other dry — the maker has accounted for this in the tiller.

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.description: An ash-shafted throwing spear, the head socketed and pinned with two iron rivets; the pinning is Verge work, the head is not.

weapons.name: Carbine
weapons.description: A long-barrelled firearm common enough on the Verge to be standard issue; the mechanism arrived through a rift and has been reproduced badly a dozen times since, which is why no two look quite alike.

weapons.name: Sidearm
weapons.description: A compact one-handed firearm, short enough to draw from the hip; the grip plate is stamped with a maker's mark in an alphabet no one has translated, and the barrel shows thirty years of use.

weapons.name: Longarm
weapons.description: A heavy two-handed firearm built for distance; the stock is reinforced with an iron spine older than the Verge settlement that sold it, and the barrel has been relined once with a sleeve that doesn't quite match.

weapons.name: Shortsword
weapons.description: A narrow double-edged blade, the grind lines still visible near the spine; the grip panels are bone, pinned through the tang, replacing whatever was there before.

weapons.name: Sword
weapons.description: The blade is good steel from somewhere colder — the cross-guard is Verge iron, fitted later, proportioned slightly wrong for the blade it carries.

weapons.name: Battleaxe
weapons.description: A wide single-bit blade broad enough to serve as a butchering tool; the eye is cracked and relined with a copper sleeve, which has held longer than anyone expected.

weapons.name: Greatclub
weapons.description: A dense foreign timber, gnarled and close-grained and heavier than its size suggests; the grip end is wrapped in raw hide that dried hard on the Verge's cold nights.

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.description: A long blade with a short unsharpened ricasso suggesting it was designed to be half-swarded; the original pommel weight has been replaced with a river stone wrapped in iron wire.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.description: A single-edged blade on a long pole, the socket bound with three rings of Coldcast Bronze — cold on one face, warm on the other — a repair that cost more than the weapon.

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.description: A composite polearm head combining axe blade, back spike, and upper point; the poll spike is a replacement in slightly darker steel, welded on the Verge by someone who knew the work.

weapons.name: Axe
weapons.description: One cheek of the head is stamped with a radial pattern, the other plain — either two different cultures made the halves, or one culture's die broke mid-run.

weapons.name: Club
weapons.description: A dense length of foreign hardwood, the bark stripped and the surface worn smooth by use; the weight sits in the head naturally, without artificial loading.

weapons.name: Longbow
weapons.description: A war bow from a taller culture — the stave is longer than most Verge archers are built for, and the grip has been built up with leather padding to compensate.

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.description: A slender thrusting blade with a swept hilt suggesting formal dueling culture; the blade is clean, but the knuckle bow shows two old repairs in different wire gauges.

weapons.name: Light Hammer
weapons.description: A short-hafted hammer meant to be thrown in pairs; the head is Verge-cast, but the balance was copied from a foreign original nobody local could explain.

weapons.name: Sickle
weapons.description: A tight-curved blade built for harvest work before someone decided it did other work just as well; the edge is honed past what any field needs.

weapons.name: Dart
weapons.description: A weighted needle of a thing, fletched with scrap leather; a dozen ride loose in a belt pouch and nobody remembers where the first one came from.

weapons.name: Flail
weapons.description: A hinged length of chain between haft and head, the join a Kethara design nobody local has fully reproduced; the weight arrives a half-beat after the swing looks finished.

weapons.name: Warhammer
weapons.description: A two-handed hammer with a head too large for its haft by local proportions; whatever alloy it's cast from is denser than it looks, and it never seems to chip.

weapons.name: War Pick
weapons.description: A hooked spike balanced opposite a hammer face, built to punch through plate rather than cut it; the spike is a later graft, welded on in a style that doesn't match the rest.

weapons.name: Hammer
weapons.description: A flat-faced hammer on a haft long enough to swing two-handed when the grip demands it; the poll is stamped with a foreign maker's mark half worn away.

weapons.name: Whip
weapons.description: Braided cord over a wire core, the tip weighted with a bead of Coldcast Bronze; it reaches further than its length should allow.

weapons.name: Trident
weapons.description: A three-tined spear balanced for throwing as readily as thrusting; the tines are cold-worked steel, riveted to a haft that's seen saltwater nowhere near the Verge.

weapons.name: Pike
weapons.description: A spearhead on a haft twice the length a single hand could manage; unwieldy anywhere but a line, and useless anywhere but a line.

weapons.name: Blowgun
weapons.description: A hollow reed reinforced with a foreign lacquer; the needles it fires barely mark flesh unless something's been done to the tip.

armor.name: Half Plate
armor.description: Shaped pauldrons, vambraces, and a breastplate in mixed origin — the chest is one culture's work, the arm pieces another's, the gaps bridged with riveted mail from a Verge armorer.

armor.name: Common Clothes
armor.description: Layered garments in the Varathi fashion — mismatched weaves and dye lots, everything washed to near-uniform grey by road dust and rain.

armor.name: Leather Armor
armor.description: Boiled hide cut from two different tannages and laced together where the sizes didn't meet; the shoulder patches are a third material, stiff and dark.

armor.name: Studded Leather
armor.description: The backing is Verge-tanned leather; the studs are punched from a sheet of imported metal, their heads a slightly different colour than the iron rivets holding the straps.

armor.name: Hide Armor
armor.description: Pelts from at least three different creatures, stitched together with gut and rawhide; one hide has a texture no one on the Verge has named yet.

armor.name: Chain Shirt
armor.description: Interlocked rings in two gauges — the torso section is finer work, the sleeves a rougher repair in thicker wire that clinks differently when walked.

armor.name: Scale Mail
armor.description: Overlapping scales riveted to a leather backing in three different metals and at least two different shapes, all sourced from whatever was available when the backing needed filling.

armor.name: Breastplate
armor.description: A single-piece chest and back plate shaped for a body that wasn't quite this one; the inside is padded with folded linen and rough cord ties where the original buckles were.

armor.name: Ring Mail
armor.description: A leather coat with heavy iron rings sewn through it in rows; the rings on the left side are smaller and closer-spaced, salvaged from a different garment.

armor.name: Chain Mail
armor.description: Full interlocked mail, heavy and tight-linked; the coif is a separate piece tied on, and the rings at the neck are a slightly different temper — they catch the light differently.

armor.name: Plate Mail
armor.description: Full articulated plate in matched steel, the closest thing to manufacture-consistent equipment on the Verge; it arrived through a rift already fitted for someone else, and has been adjusted in seven places.

armor.name: Padded Armor
armor.description: Quilted layers stitched over scavenged batting; better than nothing, and loud enough to prove it.

armor.name: Splint Armor
armor.description: Overlapping vertical strips riveted to a leather backing, half of them a mismatched foreign alloy; heavier than plate and half as elegant.

shields.name: Shield
shields.description: Planked or faced wood with an iron boss; the boards are from two different trees, and the grip has been replaced with leather cord wound over a carved wooden core.

consumables.name: Quiver of Arrows
consumables.description: A cylindrical leather quiver, the stitching done twice where it split along the seam; the arrows inside are mixed — three different fletching patterns, two point styles, all matched to the same shaft diameter.

consumables.name: Shot Cartridge
consumables.description: A small leather pouch of cast shot — lead balls or something close to it, uniform enough to load clean but clearly poured by hand on the Verge.

consumables.name: Potion of Healing
consumables.description: A stoppered glass vial, the glass thick and slightly green; inside, a liquid the colour of old copper that smells of iron and warm stone.

consumables.name: Potion of Greater Healing
consumables.description: A squat clay bottle sealed with wax; the liquid inside moves slowly when tilted, dark red with a faint iridescence at the surface.

consumables.name: Potion of Superior Healing
consumables.description: A frosted glass cylinder with a metal-wire bail closure; the liquid is nearly black and smells of deep water and something faintly resinous.

consumables.name: Potion of Supreme Healing
consumables.description: A heavy flat-sided vessel in pale blue-green glass, sealed with a gasketed stopper; the liquid inside has no smell at all, which is more unsettling than any odour would be.

consumables.name: Scroll of Identify
consumables.description: A tight-rolled scroll on pale vellum, the ink a warm brown-black; the script is too small to read without holding it close to light, and the letters have no serifs.

consumables.name: Scroll of Fireball
consumables.description: A scroll cased in a blackened iron tube, the cap fixed with a half-turn; the parchment inside is warm to the touch and smells of char and dry air.

consumables.name: Scroll of Dispel Magic
consumables.description: A folded sheet of stiff paper rather than rolled vellum; the marks on it are geometric rather than written, intersecting lines that seem to cancel each other out.

gear.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
gear.description: A battered canvas pack carried by someone who has been underground before — the straps are reinforced with salvaged leather, and the crowbar head is wrapped in rag to stop it rattling.

gear.name: Explorer's Pack
gear.description: A wide-mouthed pack loaded for open country; the bedroll lashes on in the Kethara fashion, and the waterskin is double-bladdered against the risk of a seam failure.

gear.name: Scholar's Pack
gear.description: A soft-sided leather case worn by someone who moves often but carefully; the ink bottle is nested in its own stitched compartment, and the parchment is wrapped in oilcloth.

gear.name: Priest's Pack
gear.description: A worn pack smelling of incense and cold stone; the censer nestles inside the vestments, and the alms box has been repaired with a strip of tin over the cracked corner.

gear.name: Burglar's Pack
gear.description: A low-profile pack with everything sorted for access in the dark; the ball bearings are in a drawstring bag inside a bag, and the lantern is wrapped in dark cloth.

gear.name: Component Pouch
gear.description: A small belt-mounted pouch in stiff Verge-tanned leather, each pocket sized for a different material; the clasp is a bone toggle worn smooth.

gear.name: Holy Symbol
gear.description: Cast or carved from whatever material was available when the maker needed it; the Verge has no universal pantheon, so the symbol's design tells you which world it came from.

gear.name: Spellbook
gear.description: A compact bound volume in dark leather, the spine reinforced with iron wire; the blank pages are vellum from at least two different tanneries, slightly different in weight.

gear.name: Thieves' Tools
gear.description: A roll of oiled cloth holding small iron instruments, each custom-filed for specific lock geometries; one pick has a replacement tip soldered on in a different metal.

gear.name: Healer's Kit
gear.description: A flat leather pouch opening to reveal rolled bandages, a stoppered salve pot, and thin splint wood tied in a bundle; the bandages are clean but have been washed more than once.

gear.name: Traveler's Clothes
gear.description: Layered garments in mixed-climate weights — a light linen beneath a heavier outer layer — worn by anyone who has learned that the Verge's weather doesn't negotiate.

gear.name: Common Clothes
gear.description: Undyed or once-dyed garments in whatever cloth was available; the Verge's textile trade is patchwork, and it shows.

gear.name: Prayer Book
gear.description: A small sewn-signature volume, the cover board warped slightly from moisture; the prayers inside are from a world the reader may not have come from.

gear.name: Incense
gear.description: A stick of resin and aromatic wood that burns with a pale smoke; the scent is unfamiliar on the Verge, which is often the point.

gear.name: Vestments
gear.description: Formal layered cloth in colours that meant something in a specific ritual context; worn by someone who carried them across a rift and hasn't stopped wearing them.

gear.name: Crowbar
gear.description: A length of Verge-forged iron, the bend slightly off-true, which doesn't affect its utility; one end is worn bright from use, the other still shows mill scale.

gear.name: Pouch
gear.description: A small drawstring bag in rough Verge leather, sized for coins or shot or small trade goods; the drawstring has been replaced with cord.

gear.name: Dark Clothes
gear.description: Close-woven cloth in deep brown or grey rather than true black — true black dye is an import on the Verge, and expensive.

gear.name: Book
gear.description: A bound volume in whatever hide was available for the cover; the spine tells you roughly how old the stitching is.

gear.name: Parchment
gear.description: A single sheet of prepared hide, scraped thin and dried flat; the Verge produces it in irregular sizes depending on what animal was available.

gear.name: Ink
gear.description: A small stoppered bottle of carbon-and-gum ink, dark enough to be black when it dries; the stopper is wax-sealed against the Verge's variable humidity.

gear.name: Ink Pen
gear.description: A cut quill or turned wooden pen, the nib trimmed for a fine line; feather quills on the Verge come from birds no one has named.

gear.name: Robes
gear.description: Long outer garments in whatever weave was available — scholar, traveler, or someone who arrived wearing them and has nothing else.

gear.name: Shovel
gear.description: A square-bladed iron shovel with a hardwood haft; the blade is stamped with a foundry mark in a script no one reads anymore.

gear.name: Iron Pot
gear.description: A heavy-walled iron pot, the handle riveted through the rim; the inside is seasoned black from years of use on varied fires.

gear.name: Artisan's Tools
gear.description: A roll of tools specific to one craft — the metal instruments are a mix of local and rift-origin manufacture, and the maker's preferences are legible in the wear patterns.

gear.name: Gaming Set
gear.description: Dice, tokens, or cards in a drawstring bag; the symbols on the dice are not all from the same counting system, which creates interesting debates about which face is which number.

gear.name: Rope (50 ft)
gear.description: Fifty feet of twisted hemp, the surface weathered but the core still tight; spliced at one end where it broke and was joined rather than replaced.

gear.name: Rations (1 day)
gear.description: A day's compressed and preserved food, wrapped in cloth or packed in a small tin; the ingredients are whatever the Verge had available, which changes by region.

gear.name: Torch
gear.description: A dense timber handle wrapped in tallow-soaked fibre; the wood burns the fat more than itself, which is why it lasts.

materials.name: Animal Pelt
materials.description: A rough pelt from one of the Verge's unnamed beasts, the fur dense and two-toned in a pattern that suggests a climate no longer accessible.

materials.name: Animal Bone
materials.description: Dense and slightly heavier than expected for its size; the marrow has a faint iridescence not present in bones from source-world animals.

materials.name: Raw Meat
materials.description: Muscle tissue from a Verge creature — darker than familiar meats, with a grain that runs in unusual directions.

materials.name: Rare Hide
materials.description: A pelt from a creature that exists only in the convergence — the follicle pattern has no analogue in any taxonomist's record, and the hide cures differently from either of its apparent source species.

materials.name: Exotic Meat
materials.description: Meat from a creature that arrived through a rift and adapted; the flavour is edible but disorienting to anyone who recognises one of the parent species.

materials.name: Magical Bone
materials.description: A bone that holds a faint interior warmth and a residual resonance — not enchanted deliberately, but saturated by proximity to a convergence event.

materials.name: Enchanted Pelt
materials.description: A pelt whose fur changes orientation slowly against any wind, responding to something in the air that has nothing to do with weather.

materials.name: Bone Dust
materials.description: Fine grey powder ground from the calcified remains of undead that persisted long enough to lose biological form; smells of cold stone.

materials.name: Tarnished Coin
materials.description: A coin from some prior settlement or source world, the face worn to near-nothing; the alloy is consistent and probably not Verge-origin.

materials.name: Rotted Cloth
materials.description: Degraded fibre from something that was once garment; the weave is still partially legible if held to light, which suggests it was once finely made.

materials.name: Cursed Bone
materials.description: A bone whose surface is cold regardless of ambient temperature; the cold is uniform and doesn't radiate — it simply is.

materials.name: Grave Dirt
materials.description: Soil saturated with the residue of deliberate burial — the Verge's rituals vary, but the earth remembers something was put there.

materials.name: Necrotic Essence
materials.description: A sealed vial of dark liquid that absorbs light at its surface; the glass is slightly warm where the contents are cold.

materials.name: Ancient Coin
materials.description: A struck coin from before the current settlement era, the stamp clear enough to show it was official currency somewhere that no longer sends people here.

materials.name: Soul Gem
materials.description: A dense mineral vessel containing something that shifts faintly in low light; the gem itself is unremarkable, but what is inside it isn't mineral.
